description: This file contains test utilities for ConnectionEndpointMetadata, including a custom matcher class EndpointMetadataMatcher, functions to create matchers, and an operator overload for output streaming of ConnectionEndpointMetadata objects.

classes.name: EndpointMetadataMatcher

methods.description: Describes the negation of the matcher.
